items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: The interviewer mentions Doc Higgins in the context of the South Memphis Jug Band, but the interviewee (Mose Allison Sr.) does not respond with any personal interaction or memory of him.

ctx.x: He played guitar. Doc Higgins. They had the South Memphis Jug Band. He blowed the jug. That big fella. Called Doc Higgins.
